targets.query: default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] in ('api_request','claude_code.api_request') | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])) by day=bin(timestamp, 1d) | sort by day asc

default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])) by portfolio=tostring(resource['business.portfolio.id']), project=tostring(resource['business.project.id']) | sort by cost_usd desc | take 30

default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | extend feature=tostring(resource['business.feature.id']) | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])) by attribution=iff(isempty(feature),'unattributed','attributed')

default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request' | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])) by team=tostring(resource['business.team.id']) | sort by cost_usd desc | take 30

panels.title: Planned AI budget by project and feature

targets.query: default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'engineering-work' | where isnotempty(tostring(attributes['feature_id'])) | summarize planned_ai_budget_usd=max(todouble(attributes['planned_ai_budget_usd'])), completion_pct=max(todouble(attributes['completion_pct'])) by project=tostring(attributes['project_id']), feature=tostring(attributes['feature_id']) | sort by planned_ai_budget_usd desc | take 50

default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request' | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])) by day=bin(timestamp, 1d), project=tostring(resource['business.project.id']) | sort by day asc | take 2000

default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request' | extend model=tostring(attributes['model']) | summarize requests=count(), reported_cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])) by model=iff(isempty(model),'unpriced-or-missing',model) | sort by reported_cost_usd desc | take 50

panels.title: Feature AI budget, actual spend, and forecast

targets.query: let plan=default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'engineering-work' | where isnotempty(tostring(attributes['feature_id'])) | summarize budget=max(todouble(attributes['planned_ai_budget_usd'])), completion=max(todouble(attributes['completion_pct'])) by feature=tostring(attributes['feature_id']); let actual=default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request' | summarize actual_spend=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])) by feature=tostring(resource['business.feature.id']); plan | join kind=leftouter actual on feature | extend forecast=iff(completion >= 10, actual_spend/(completion/100.0), real(null)) | project feature, budget, actual_spend, completion, forecast | sort by actual_spend desc | take 100
